# Joshua Glenn Gulbin | Frontend React Web Developer

> Portfolio of Joshua Glenn R. Gulbin (GulbinDev), a front-end web developer who builds fast, responsive, and maintainable interfaces with React, Next.js, and TypeScript.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://portfolio-gulbindev.vercel.app/): Overview of Joshua's front-end services, technical expertise, core technology stacks, workflow, and contact options.
- [Projects](https://portfolio-gulbindev.vercel.app/projects): Portfolio of self-built projects demonstrating front-end development skills and practical experience.
- [About](https://portfolio-gulbindev.vercel.app/about): Background, experience with React.js, server-side rendering, TypeScript, performance, SEO, soft skills, and current areas of growth.
